label: verify-t1-reporter-alt

claims.claim: Lac RBS library Hill refit: EC50 moves 4.9-fold (O1) and 17.5-fold (O2); n changes at most 0.116 and 0.150 relative; no pair separable at 95%; O3 uninformative.
claims.source_says: O1 EC50 range 39.8-196.6 uM, fold 4.94 | n range 1.37-1.54; max pairwise dn = 0.116; 0 of 15 pairs. O2 fold 17.47, n 1.46-1.69, max dn = 0.150, 0 of 15. O3 n range 0.87-1.89.
claims.note: I re-ran the agent's script on the CSV (hash matches, 2.5 min) and every number reproduced; this verifies the arithmetic of their own fit, not an external source.

claims.claim: Strongest published rival: molecular titration makes steepness depend on abundance, so an RBS change should move n.
claims.source_says: both the threshold and the degree of ultrasensitivity depend upon the abundance of the inhibitor, exactly as we observed experimentally.
claims.note: The abstract supports dependence on inhibitor abundance in a yeast sequestration circuit; that it applies to RBS-tuned repressors and is the 'strongest' rival is the agent's extrapolation.

claims.claim: Lac plateau falls with repressor copy number (O1 fitted plateau 1.03 at R=11 to 0.44 at R=870), so RBS change is not a pure log-axis translation.
claims.note: Re-run reproduces plateau 1.034 falling monotonically to 0.437; the inference about non-translation and checking Cello ymax/ymin is reasonable.

claims.claim: Law set 1.8.1 has no Hill or reporter law (gene-regulatory-dynamics still a gap) and no longer contains the Turing lemmas the earlier law-mapper cited.
claims.source_says: "class": "gap", "status": "proposed", version 1.0.0, lean_ref module null; note: "not formalised: the map records links ... not dynamics". Lawset 1.8.1 mentions only turing-ddi (candidate); no WellMixedStable in .lean.
claims.note: Local files match; I grepped the lawset and laws directory for hill/reporter and found none, though I did not read all 59 laws individually.

overall: Three of four key claims are supported. The fourth is partly supported: Buchler and Cross 2009 shows threshold and steepness depending on inhibitor abundance, but the step to RBS-tuned repressors is the agent's extrapolation. The lac refit reproduced exactly when I re-ran the script. I ran it without Python's -I flag because that flag hides numpy.
